help.pages.first: 1 Overview · 2 Proxies · 3 Profiles (keys enter page content)
help.navigation.tab: Tab / Shift+Tab: next / previous control; navigation and each list form one stop.
help.navigation.arrows: Sidebar ↑↓ / j/k: switch pages; → / l / Enter: focus content without activating a control.
help.navigation.scroll: Sidebar Home / End: first / last page. In content, PgUp / PgDn / Home / End scroll.
help.navigation.cancel: Esc returns one layer; ordinary content and vertical lists also accept ← / h. Horizontal controls keep their own keys. Ctrl+C cancels safely and quits.
help.proxies.expand: Enter expands a group. In a Selector group, Enter applies a member; →/l enters a referenced group. i inspects details; Esc returns through the page hierarchy.
help.proxies.options: DIRECT and REJECT are valid choices. Automatic groups expose details only. In two columns, ↑↓ stays in the column; →/l on a leaf moves right and ←/h moves left before returning.
help.profiles.add: a: focus the source input; Add subscription fetches and names the profile automatically.
help.profiles.import: New profile: add a URL or local YAML with a name and description, then keep its source for updates.
help.profiles.rename: Rename preserves your custom display name across subscription updates; Edit address replaces a profile's download address.
help.profiles.grid: Arrows / hjkl: browse cards; ← / h stays in the grid. Enter opens details; Esc returns to navigation. Use profile / Apply changes loads a profile.
help.profiles.actions: Tab / Shift+Tab: visit actions, including controls below the fold. Esc closes details.
help.profiles.update: Update / Update all saves configuration changes without loading them into the core.
help.profiles.overrides: Overrides imports a separate overrides YAML draft.
help.profiles.delete: Delete requires the exact display name. The selected profile is protected.
help.connections.keys: /: search · Enter: details · x: review closing one connection
help.connections.confirm: Closing requires confirmation of the displayed connection; other connections stay active.
help.rules.keys: /: search · Enter: details · g / Ctrl+R: refresh
help.rules.readOnly: Rules are read only and remain in the core's matching order.
help.settings.ports: Runtime settings / Ports: edit local proxy and control API ports.
help.settings.review: Review changed listeners and restart impact before applying; existing API credentials remain private.
help.settings.persistence: Routing mode and autostart use the same persistent settings as the CLI.
help.settings.tun: The root system instance can enable TUN for the entire host after confirmation; user services cannot enable TUN.
help.logs.keys: f: pause/resume · End: follow · /: search · g: reconnect
help.logs.liveOnly: Only live logs are available. Pausing disconnects; events during a pause are not retained.
help.logs.retention: The view retains at most 200 redacted entries in memory. No raw log history is written.
help.overview.install: i: install/manage core · b: install a local executable
help.overview.import: n: download method · a: add/import profile
help.overview.controls: Core: start, stop or restart; routing mode: Rule / Global / Direct.
help.overview.refresh: Controls refresh the observed state after the operation.
help.overview.unavailable: System proxy controls are unavailable. Host TUN requires the root system instance and explicit confirmation.
help.core.title: Core and configuration
help.core.actions: In content: s start · x stop · r restart (Connections uses x for one connection).
help.core.quit: Quitting closes this interface; systemd continues to own Mihomo.
help.forms.title: Forms and dialogs
help.forms.keys: Tab / Shift+Tab: change controls · Enter: activate · Esc: back
help.forms.input: Inputs, editors, dialogs and menus keep their own keys; printable keys, including q and 1–7, belong to the active input.
help.forms.modal: Modal dialogs capture input and restore the previous page on close.
help.messages.title: Messages
help.messages.retention: Errors remain across pages and later operations until closed. Success lasts 3 visible seconds; info lasts 4.
help.messages.shared: Installation and network configuration use the same application use cases as the CLI.
